rowDetection.Temas: A non-empty TemaID identifies a persisted theme. Boolean-only placeholder rows are not records; a named row without ID is an import candidate.
rowDetection.GrupoTemas: A non-empty VinculoID identifies a persisted assignment. Boolean-only placeholder rows are not records; Group or TemaID without VinculoID requires validation.

GrupoTemas.Grupo: canonical Coles name; resolve aliases on read

constraints: Each active theme has a positive integer order and at least one type.
Boolean types are independent and may overlap.
Equal orders conflict only when active themes share a selected type.
One assignment per normalized group identity and TemaID, including archived assignments.
Marking Repasando does not set UltimoRepaso.
Never write to Detalle or Coles.
